audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's TL;DR (and the identical report[0].t) says 'Wind Wall blocks Q, RQ, and W's tether'. The content layer says the exact opposite: 'your W tether is a target-lock, not a projectile — Wind Wall does NOT block it'.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a targeted tether with no projectile flag in the kit; Wind Wall blocks projectiles only. The two layers shipped opposite answers to the single most important interaction in the matchup, and the full-layer version tells the user to give up her one reliable answer to Yasuo.
audit.corrected: TL;DR and report[0] restated: Wind Wall eats Q and RQ, not the W tether; root him through the wall.
sources: ownerKit W (no projectile flag, targeted tether)

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Yasuo levels 3, 4-5 and first item and gave Karma level 6, while diff read EVEN, diffRating 8/10 and the summary line said 'Hard matchup' — against a 54.24% Karma win rate.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Skill, Karma, Yasuo, which is exactly what the content whys describe: Karma bullies until crit items, level 6 is even, 2+ items is his.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, 5 to Karma and row 4 to Skill on both layers; difficulty 5/10, carry threat 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase whys were boilerplate and put Yasuo's spike in the wrong places.
audit.why: His real spikes are level 6 Last Breath off a Q3 knockup (70s at rank 1) and two crit items. Karma's level 6 is a dip, not a spike, because Mantra exists from level 1.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0..6].why to the Wind Wall bait pattern and the crit-item flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns described Wind Wall with no cooldown and no duration.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17s and stands for 4 seconds — long enough that baiting it with a cheap Q and firing the real poke afterwards is a repeatable pattern, not a one-off.
audit.corrected: Added rank-1 and rank-5 cooldowns plus the 4-second duration, and the bait sequence.

edits.before: Track Yasuo’s Wind Wall: Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Wind Wall blocks Q and RQ for 4 seconds on a 25s cooldown at rank 1 — but your W tether is target-locked, so it roots him straight through the wall.

edits.before: Tax the approach, survive the dive, and grind him down between windows. Shorthand: Wind Wall down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Bait Wind Wall with a cheap Q — it is 25s at rank 1 — then land the real poke and root him through it with W.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s at rank 5, and it stands 4 seconds — bait it with a cheap Q, then fire the real one. - Your W tether is not a projectile, so root him straight through the wall. - Hold E for his E-dash step-up, never for poke.

edits.before: Open the toll booth: Q every last-hit, RQ the cooldown gaps, and hold E strictly for Wind Wall. The lane is yours until he spikes.
edits.after: Level 1 is brutal for him: RQ Soulflare his step-ups, bait Wind Wall with a cheap Q, and hold E for the E-dash, not for poke.

edits.before: Q poke at level 1 is among the best in the game — chunk Yasuo on every last-hit and start the Mantra economy.
edits.after: Mantra is up at level 1 — RQ Soulflare threatens first blood and his melee Q range can't answer it.

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: No minion to E-dash onto and one Wind Wall charge — your Q chips him while Gathering Fire refunds.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: Bait-then-real-Q beats a single Wind Wall, and your W tether is target-locked, so the wall never blocks the root.

edits.before: Spam the RQ slow-field on his farming spots and keep your shield for Wind Wall — the lane is a toll booth and you own it.
edits.after: Your bullying peak — repeated Q into RQ Soulflare push him off the wave and let you tax plates behind Inspire's speed.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Even at 6 — Last Breath off a Q3 knockup arrives while your Mantra is only the empowerment you already had.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: Your first AP or haste item sharpens RQ while he is still pre-crit — reclaim the bully window.

edits.before: You drift toward utility now — peel, shield, and speed your carries while the RQ poke softens objectives.
edits.after: Two crit items plus Wind Wall uptime let him eat a Q and all-in your thin frame — let the team handle him.

notes: Highest-value fix in my slice: the full layer told users Wind Wall blocks Focused Resolve. It does not — the tether is targeted, not a projectile — and the content layer already said so, so the page contradicted itself on the one interaction that decides the lane. tone is '#ff5d6c' (the hard/red token) while the lane is 54% for Karma; QA should move it to the EVEN colour now that diffRating is 5/10.
